note: Every signal is logged the day it is made, before the outcome is known, and scored once the session has happened. Nothing here is backfilled by hand.

cautions.young: The record starts the day this was first run. Early numbers are noise - a handful of calls cannot distinguish a real edge from luck.
cautions.one_signal: Only the early-warning score is scored here. Other signals are logged for the record but not yet graded.
cautions.no_shifting: The threshold and the big-day definition are fixed in the code, not chosen after seeing results.
